project_type: FastAPI backend + Next.js 14 frontend + Kotlin Android agent, multi-platform DLP system
build_system: FastAPI (no build needed for backend), npm/typescript for frontend, gradle for Android
build_command: backend: uvicorn main:app --reload; frontend: npm run dev; android: ./gradlew assembleDebug
test_command: backend: pytest backend/tests/; frontend: npm run test; android: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest
verification_instructions: Run backend tests after database changes. Verify API endpoints with curl or Swagger (http://localhost:8000/docs). Test enrollment flow end-to-end with a real device or emulator. Check frontend builds without errors and pages render correctly. Ensure Android app compiles and APK deploys to test device.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Database migrations auto-generated by SQLAlchemy. APK files generated by gradle (not checked in). QR code SVGs generated runtime via qrcode library.
environment_constraints: SQLite used for dev (no schema migration tool required). PostgreSQL in production (via Docker Compose). Android Keystore requires device hardware or emulator. Do NOT bypass OAuth or device provisioning security. Backend SERVER_PUBLIC_URL must be set for Android DPC provisioning. Firebase integration is optional (fallback to basic JWT).
contribution_requirements: Read ARCHITECTURE.md and API.md before implementing. Follow existing SQLAlchemy ORM patterns. Use existing auth.py JWT patterns. Match frontend component style (dark theme, Tailwind, recharts). Android code must follow existing Kotlin conventions and use safe null checks. All new API endpoints under /api/v1/ prefix. Test before committing. Use specific paths and exact commands—no generic instructions.
key_patterns: SQLAlchemy ORM models in backend/models.py with _utc_now() for timestamps. Hashed tokens stored in database (never plaintext). Device ID format: platform-specific prefixes (dg-win-, dg-android-, etc.) followed by hex entropy. Enrollment tokens: one-time-use, 10-minute expiry (configurable), SHA-256 hashed. Frontend API client uses apiFetch (adds Bearer token, handles 401). React hooks patterns with useEffect, useState, useCallback. Android uses Kotlin coroutines, LiveData, and safe null checks (?. and ?:).
directory_structure: backend/: FastAPI app, models, routes, auth, database. frontend/: Next.js app router, pages, components, lib/api client. mobile/android/: Gradle project, Kotlin sources in app/src/main/java/com/dataghost/agent/. Tests in backend/tests/, frontend/__tests__/, mobile/android/app/src/test/. Migrations in backend/migrations/versions/.
